title: I made a website which gives you a quant grade analysis for your list of stocks in plain english.
author: Unique_Knight_9512
selftext:
I have made Q-netix,A portfolio optimisation tool which allocates the percentage of capital for each stock..You just give it a list of stocks and it runs complex math analysis in seconds and gives you a no bs portfolio.Spoiler:You don’t need a quant degree.  
Seems too good to be true?Well,try it and give your opinions.

comments.author: MendozaHolmes
comments.body: backend system prompt: "You are Quantitative Analyst, make no mistakes"

comments.author: QuanTradin
comments.body: allocating across a list of stocks usually means some form of mean-variance, and that tends to pile into whatever had the best last year. what lookback does it fit the weights on?

replies.author: Unique_Knight_9512
replies.body:
It uses a pipeline:  
QUBO algorithm->QAOA(Quantum hardware simulation)  
Also uses HMM for history projections.  
Based on the capital amount(which is automatically calculated based on your list of stocks).  
You can look into the docs section for more detailed info.

replies.author: QuanTradin
replies.body: I'd test the HMM hardest, regime models fit history beautifully and then switch a few weeks late once it's live. running the picks forward on paper for a couple of months would tell you more than the docs can. Quantradin, the thing I built, does that forward run with fake money. quantradin.com
